## Plane crash info example

```{r crashes, results= 'hold'}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# This should now print without the error
crash_page

# How many <table> elements are on the page?
crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()

crash_df = crash_tables[[1]]
print(crash_df)

# From a cleaning perspective, there are several things that can be changed:
# [1] Replace the columns with the first row
# [2] Have better column type
# [3] There are possible things to do to clean the data within columns; e.g. split columns that contain multiple pieces of information
# Column 4 has: fatalities/# passengers (ground fatalities)

# for today's class, we will focus on first two
colnames(crash_df) = crash_df[1, ] 
#then delete first row
crash_df = crash_df[-1, ]

crash_df = crash_df |>  dplyr::mutate(Date = lubridate::dmy(Date))

head(crash_df)
```

## Game

```{r}
page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")
classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements(".Dreadnought") |>
  rvest::html_text2()
length(classes) 



base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts))
for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |>  rvest:: html_text2(),
    value = pg |> rvest::html_elements(" div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |> rvest::html_text2() |> readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)   # robots.txt asks for it
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)
registry |>  dplyr::filter(class== "Dreadnought") |>  dplyr::mutate(value = as.numeric(value))-> Dreadnoughts_df

sum(Dreadnoughts_df$value)
```

## Structured Text Exraction

### Course Information

```{r}
chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna",
  params=ellmer::params(reasoning_effort="none")
)

isa125_text = rvest::read_html("https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/isa/") |>    rvest::html_element("#sc_sccoursesdescs >div:nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2()

chat$chat_structured(
  isa125_text, 
  type = ellmer::type_object(
    name=ellmer::type_string(
      description = "Name of the course. For example, ISA 235.  Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise. Do not include the parentheses for the credit hour and do not end with a period"
    ),
    description = ellmer::type_string(description = "The description of the course without the prereqs.")
  )
)
```
